sequence_definition: BMRB27258 deposited135-residue experimental-domain sequence; no invented expression tag.
construct_qualification: The deposited 135-residue sequence is used for the intrinsic-rate calculation. The paper describes an N-terminal His tag. PDB Met9 belongs to the tag and is omitted from the mapping to NMR Leu3. NMR residues 1–3 and 134–135 fall outside the verified coordinate core.

conditions.assumption_note: The reported buffer pH before lyophilization is the uncorrected PF input unless an explicit pD or conflicting conditions override it. No explicit corrected pD or measured post-reconstitution pH was found.
conditions.buffer: PBS: 10 mM Na2HPO4 (pH 7.4), 137 mM NaCl, 1.8 mM KH2PO4, 2.7 mM KCl

method.dG_interpretation: HX opening/protection free energy under EX2 interpretation; not global unfolding free energy
